event.title: Compatibility bridge withdrawn; migration deadline passes

sources.locator: P1 — interface release and affected revenue
sources.text: Synthetic operating evidence, compiled July 13, 2027. HelioForge's identity-platform vendor published its generally available breaking authentication endpoint on June 10, 2027. The supported identity platform is used by customers representing 18% of FluxRail's consolidated fiscal 2026 revenue, counted once across customer groups. The vendor continued to make its published endpoint and migration documentation available to FluxRail. The CFO first received the consolidated failure report at 10:00 a.m. New York time on July 13.

sources.locator: P2 — bridge withdrawal and release status
sources.text: The compatibility bridge described in the June 16 management note passed staging tests. A July 5 production security test subsequently showed that it bypassed a required token-expiry control; FluxRail quarantined the bridge that day and did not offer it as a secure workaround thereafter. The July 12 release register, closed at 5:30 p.m. New York time, records: No compatible production connector has been deployed and no documented secure customer workaround is available. The same status remained open at 9:00 a.m. on July 13. The lender's complete consent and waiver register through July 13 contains no extension or waiver of the interface-remediation deadline.

sources.locator: P3 — continuing service and evidence limits
sources.text: The old authentication endpoint continued operating during the vendor's transition window. FluxRail's incident ledger through July 13 records no production incident preventing a regulated approval workflow for more than four consecutive hours. Customers have not delivered written termination or nonrenewal notices. Subscription fees and terms remain unchanged, and FluxRail retains administrative and export control over the configuration library. No later connector deployment, lender decision, current-quarter debt register, bank balance, or trailing-four-quarter EBITDA bridge is contained in this evidence package.

summary: The event reveals a breaking authentication endpoint change for HelioForge, used by 18% of revenue, with the compatibility bridge quarantined and no workaround deployed as of July 12. This weakens the renewal‑reliability (A01) and connector‑support‑continuity (A06) assumptions, triggers S1 noncompliance (missed 30‑day fix deadline), triggers C08 notice duty (knowledge of noncompliance, notice period not yet elapsed), and leaves S2 not triggered (no >4‑hour outage).

attributions.rationale: The event shows a breaking identity‑platform change affecting 18% of revenue, with the compatibility bridge quarantined and no workaround deployed, indicating weakened reliable workflow execution needed for renewals.

covenant_assessments.rationale: The vendor published a breaking interface change on June 10, 2027 affecting 18% of revenue; the Borrower had 30 calendar days (to July 10) to deploy a compatible connector or provide a documented secure workaround, but as of July 12 (and July 13) neither was done, missing the duty.

warnings: Reviewer calendar correction: Nemotron cites July 10 as the S1 deadline. July 10, 2027 is Saturday, so the agreement rolls the administrative-performance deadline to Monday July 12 at 5 p.m. The missing performance recorded after that time and on July 13 still establishes S1 noncompliance. The original model wording is preserved.
